newsitem.title: JAPAN: GOLF-JAPAN V UNITED STATES WOMEN'S 2ND-DAY MATCH RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-JAPAN V UNITED STATES WOMEN'S 2ND-DAY MATCH RESULTS.

text.p: Results on the second day of the
women's Nichirei golf match between Japan and the United States
Ikuyo Shiotani/Aki Takamura 68 lost to Barb Whitehead/Michelle
Marnie McGuire/Aiko Hashimoto 69 lost to Chris Johnson/Tracy
Aki Nakano/Kaori Higo 65 beat Emilee Klein/Kris Tschetter 66
Akane Oshiro/Toshimi Kimura 66 lost to Karrie Webb/Joan Pitcock
Miyuki Shimabukuro/Mayumi Murai 66 lost to Julie Piers/Hiromi
Ku Ok-hee/Natsuko Noro 64 beat Marianne Morris/Penny Hammel 68
Suzuko Maeda/Yukiyo Haga 67 lost to Pat Hurst/Barb Mucha 62
Kaori Harada/Michiko Hattori 68 lost to Val Skinner/Brandie
Ayako Okamoto/Akiko Fukushima 65 lost to Jane Geddes/Lise
